title: Beckman Coulter RNAdvance Viral RNA Isolation
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Add binding beads to lysed samples
steps.instruction: Load the magnetic extraction plate (magnetic module, slot 6) with a NEST 96‑deepwell plate, place up to 96 lysed samples in the wells, add the RNAdvance Viral binding beads to each well, and map each extraction well to the corresponding elution PCR well on the temperature module (slot 1) (e.g., A1→A1, B1→B1, … D2→D2). Use the two 12‑channel reservoirs for reagent layout as described in the protocol setup.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input the required protocol parameters as prompted on the parameter entry screen.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip the files if they are compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware JSON files
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any custom labware JSON files (e.g., for the NEST 96‑deepwell plate or reservoirs) if required.

steps.title: Upload protocol .py file
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Protocol tab in the Opentrons app and upload the downloaded protocol Python file (.py).

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the deck map: place the magnetic module in slot 6, the temperature module in slot 1, load the two 12‑channel reservoirs, tip racks, and any other required labware in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons app to calibrate the loaded labware, tip rack, and pipette as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press Run in the Opentrons app to execute the RNAdvance Viral RNA isolation protocol.
